Yana ci gaba da hana taɓawa har sai ka buɗe.
Kariya ta zaɓi da ke rufe allon sanarwa yayin da Screen Lock ke aiki. Ba ta karanta abin da ke kan allo.
Ya dace idan waya tana hannun yara: Telegram yana ci gaba da bayyana da aiki yayin da taɓawar allo ake hana ta.
Mataki 2 cikin 2 · Ƙara Screen Lock zuwa Quick Settings. A Android 13 ko sabo, buƙatar tsarin za ta bayyana kai tsaye.
Mataki 1 cikin 2 · Ba Screen Lock izinin bayyana a saman sauran manhajoji. Wannan izini yana ba shi damar hana taɓawa.
1 · Ba da izini a saman sauran manhajoji
Kulle na asali baya buƙatar Accessibility. Accessibility na zaɓi ne kawai don kariyar allon sanarwa ta ci gaba.
Yayin kira, buɗe Quick Settings sannan ka taɓa Screen Lock don hana taɓawa.
Ba da izinin overlay na Screen Lock
Android zai buɗe shafin manhajojin da za su iya bayyana a saman wasu. Sunan zaɓin na iya bambanta da waya.

1. Idan Android ya nuna jerin, zaɓi “Screen Lock”.
2. Kunna “Nuna a saman sauran manhajoji” ko makamancin zaɓin.
3. Koma Screen Lock.
Android yana buƙatar ka kunna wannan izini da kanka. Screen Lock yana amfani da shi ne kawai don sanya shimfiɗar taɓawa a saman kiran; baya karanta allo.
Kariyar allon sanarwa ta ci gaba
Wannan kariya ta zaɓi ce. Yayin da Screen Lock ke aiki, sabis na Accessibility da aka iyakance ga System UI yana roƙon Android ya rufe allon sanarwa da zarar an buɗe shi.
Sabis ɗin baya karanta abin da ke kan allo kuma baya nazarin Telegram. Android yana nuna shi a Accessibility saboda aikin rufe panel yana nan.
A saitunan Android, nemo “Screen Lock · Kariyar allon sanarwa”, buɗe ka kunna maɓallin, sannan ka koma nan.
Idan zaɓin ya kashe kuma Android ya nuna “Restricted setting”, buɗe App info ka nemo izinin restricted settings. Wasu nau’ikan Android na iya rashin wannan zaɓin.
Yana duba GitHub lokacin farawa kuma yana sauke sabon sigar kai tsaye. Android zai ci gaba da neman tabbatarwa kafin girkawa.
Dubawa yana amfani da public GitHub Releases API kawai. Babu asusu, analytics ko tracking.
Daga tile na Quick Settings za ka iya barin ƴan daƙiƙu don rufe panel da aje wayar kafin a hana taɓawa.
Danna dole ya fara a kan maƙasudin buɗewa kuma ya kusan zama ba motsi. Yatsa na biyu, motsi mai yawa ko sakin yatsa yana soke ƙidaya.
A 0–10%, bidiyon kira kusan baya canzawa.
Kariyar allon sanarwa ta ci gaba
Yayin da Screen Lock ke aiki, yana roƙon Android ya rufe sanarwa da Quick Settings nan take.
Yana buƙatar saitin Accessibility na zaɓi. Taɓa don ganin abin da za a kunna da dalili.
Yana nuna maƙasudin buɗewa lokacin kunnawa; daga baya yana raguwa kuma yana sake bayyana yayin danna.
Ƙaramin girgiza lokacin da buɗewa ya fara da kuma lokacin da ya ƙare.
Babu asusu kuma babu nazarin abin da ke kan allo. Intanet ana amfani da shi ne kawai don duba da sauke official GitHub releases. Overlay na cikin na’ura yana kama taɓawa ba tare da karanta allo ba.

Kulle na yau da kullum yana ƙasa da mahimman tagogin tsarin. Kariyar ci gaba na iya roƙon Android ya rufe sanarwa da Quick Settings, amma power, emergency UI da sauran wuraren tsaro suna ƙarƙashin ikon Android.
